title: Nabi ka nawasa pyaara hussain
body:
Nabi ka nawasa pyaara hussain
Ya hussain, ya hussain..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain imam hussain, haider..(8)
Hussain imam hussain
haider haider haider
<<MINI>>
Ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghode se jab zamee'n pe gire shahe karbala
shahe karbala
nikle madina chodke sultan e ambiya
sultane ambiya
<<DIVIDER>>
Haider chale najaf se baqayya se fatima
baqayya se fatima
gunji ba waqt e asr ye jibreel ki sadaa
har imteha se guzar gaya..(2)
<<MINI>>
zehra o ali ke dil ka chayn
hussain, hussain, hussain, hussain

nabi ka nawasa pyaara hussain..(2)
hussain, hussain, hussain, hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ye wo hussain hai eid pe jisko
jannat se kapde bheje khuda
haye ghareebi dasht e bala mein
hoga abhi pamaal e jafa
yahan kafan bhi na payega..(2)

2. Haan ye wahi quran e mubee'n hai
jisko padha karte the rasool
jiske liye tabdeel kiye hai
rabbe jali ne apne usool
khuda se hargiz nahi juda..(2)

3. Naaz uthaye jiske khuda ne
jiske liye naaqa the nabi
usko mile is karbobala mein
daaghe pisar aur tishna labi
hazaar zakhme utha gaya..(2)

4. Zulf e nabi ho jiska khilona
jiska bichona arsh e ola
pusht e faras se jab wo gira to
uska badan teero pe ruka
zameen par bhi na aa saka..(2)

5. Ho jiski maa ke meher mein kausar aur wo khud sardar e jina

6. Paala jise aanchal mein chupakar
binte nabi ne mere khuda

7. Jiska padhe qur'aan qasida
jiske fazael mein hai azaa'n
uske liye duniya ne uthaye
teer o tabar talwar o sina
